title: Budget Heads
rotateBody: The Excel-style table requires a landscape orientation. Please rotate your phone to see all columns, zoom controls, and search.
slAuto: Sl. No. will be auto-assigned (next available number).
importHint: Paste your draft budget JSON here. Expected format:
importNote: Budget heads are upserted by Sl. No. — existing heads keep their IDs and transaction history.
deleteNote: This will soft-delete the budget head. This action can be undone.
reqNote: This request will be sent to Admin for approval before changes are applied.
noRevs: No revisions recorded for this budget head.
noTxn: No transactions recorded against this budget head yet.
errAlloc: Allocated amount must be greater than 0
errReason: Reason must be at least 5 characters
none: No budget heads found. Click "New Budget Head" to create one.
hintAllocated: Total budget allocated across all budget heads. This is the money you have set aside for spending.
hintCommitted: Money earmarked by approved POs that has not yet been paid. Goes UP when a PO is approved, goes DOWN when a payment is made against the PO.
hintActual: Money actually spent (payments posted or direct expense).
hintPaid1: Money actually paid out via bank/cash.
hintPaid2: Money paid out via bank/cash. Equals Actual — all posted payments are reflected here.
hintAvail: Allocated − Committed − Actual. The uncommitted balance still free to spend on new POs.
